sets.name: tarmac
sets.author: TrackRS project; procedural fixtures generated by OpenAI Codex during Phase 3a
sets.source: Original analytic generation in tools/bake_terrain_materials.py; no downloaded artwork
sets.method: 64x64 periodic seeded value noise at periods 4/8/16/32, weights .40/.30/.20/.10. Albedo uses the per-surface RGB/contrast recipe; tangent normals use central differences of that noise and the per-surface strength; ORM packs AO=1, noise-varied roughness, metallic=0. bake-material creates full mip chains and BC7 sRGB albedo, BC5 linear normals and BC7 linear ORM KTX2.
